data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 庄严法庭上的正义论辩
data.description: 庄严肃穆的现代法庭辩护席前，弥子身穿剪裁利落的深灰西服套裙，一手按在判例卷宗上一手做出利落论辩手势，眼神炽热笃定。
data.action: standing at defense desk, holding legal documents, sharp confident gaze
data.lighting: balanced courtroom illumination highlighting determined facial expression
data.promptProse: Behind the defense desk of a stately courtroom, Iino Miko stands with immaculate poise in her tailored charcoal suit, presenting her brief with intellectual fire and unwavering conviction.
data.animaCaption: Miko delivering a passionate legal argument in a stately courtroom.
